column1: # Catalog of the commands this config shadows. __fish_config_shadows_write
# turns it into docs/command-shadows.json, adding each shadow's toggle and
# its current enabled state. Tab-separated columns:
#   name  identity  site  bypass  when  breaks  replacement  why
# identity and site are the __fish_config_op_enabled arguments that guard
# the shadow ("-" for the default site); identity "-" means no toggle
# removes it. when is the condition the shadow needs beyond its toggle, "-"
# for always. breaks is 1 when the shadow can break a pasted or piped
# command, so callers should use the bypass instead of the bare name.
# Every name in tests/run-tests.fish's shadow_names must appear here.
